title: Flutter Developer
description:
Experience \- 2 to 4 years


Job Summary:


* We’re looking for a passionate and skilled Flutter Developer with 2 to 4 years of hands\-on experience in building high\-performance, cross\-platform mobile applications. You will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining mobile apps for iOS and Android that deliver a seamless user experience.

Job Responsibilities:


* Develop, test, and maintain clean and efficient Flutter/Dart code.
* Build responsive and scalable mobile applications for both iOS and Android.
* Collaborate with backend developers, designers, and product managers to integrate APIs and deliver high\-quality features.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices in mobile development.
* Optimize applications for speed, performance, and reliability.
* Write unit tests, perform debugging, and ensure app stability.
* Deploy applications to Google Play Store and Apple App Store.

Required Skills \& Qualifications:


* 2–4 years of professional experience in Flutter/Dart development.
* Strong knowledge of Flutter framework and Dart programming language.
* Experience with RESTful API integration and mobile app architecture patterns.
* Familiarity with state management solutions (Provider, Bloc, Riverpod, etc.).
* Knowledge of version control systems like Git.
* Understanding of mobile app lifecycle, agile methodologies, and UI/UX principles.
* Good problem\-solving and communication skills.

Nice To Have:


* Experience with Firebase, GraphQL, or other backend services.
* Knowledge of native iOS (Swift) or Android (Kotlin/Java) development.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and app performance monitoring.
* Exposure to cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

title: Senior Android Developer
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The Digital S/W Engineer Analyst SDE \- Mobile Development is a Technology/ Engineering role involving both development and Testing. As a member of the SCRUM team, you will be
  

delivering Customer facing Banking and/or Credit Card features on digital channels such as Browser and Mobile. You will be involved in all stages of the Agile SDLC cycle. It includes but not
  

limited to (a) Requirement analysis: Grooming of user stories, Story pointing, decomposing big stories into smaller stories and define acceptance criteria. (b) Design Review: Reviewing
  

screens, flows, features, and customer communications (emails, SMS’s, notifications, PDF documents) and making sure that they are consistent with user story acceptance criteria
  

(c) Software development: Developing, configuring and debugging applications comprising of mobile frontend and Micro services. (d) Validations: Creating automated and manual test scripts
  

on BDD (Behavior Based Development) framework, executing test scripts. Identifying, triaging and fixing any defects. Conditioning and maintaining the test data. (e) Artifact
  

Ownership: Creating and maintaining testing artifacts such as Test plans and Exit reports and maintaining traceability as per SDLC guidelines. Maintaining SDLC hygiene involving stories.
  

Test cases and defects. Ensuring that no untested code goes out to production. (f) SDLC Process and Standards: Adhering to ADA (Americans with Disability Act) Guidelines, participating in
  

retrospectives, process improvement workshops, audits and performing root cause analysis. (g) Postproduction support: Supporting the technical check outs during release go live and
  

postproduction activities.


Responsibilities


* Translate application designs into code across Android/Jetpack/Kotlin development platforms as Primary Skill, with guidance from senior developers.
* Deep understanding of the **Android SDK**, platform lifecycle, and Google ecosystem (Jetpack, Android Runtime, etc.)
* Leverage AI tools such as GitHub Copilot to assist with code generation, refactoring, and debugging tasks.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of BDD (Behavior Driven Development) automated and manual test scripts in a code repository; execute scripts and record results in a test management tool.
* Use AI\-assisted tools to help accelerate unit test creation, API scaffolding, Angular components, and Spring Boot boilerplate code.
* Participate in the software development lifecycle including development, integration, and E2E testing within a CI/CD environment (e.g., RTC, Jenkins).
* Write secure, stable, testable, and maintainable code under the guidance of senior engineers, and take accountability for assigned features.
* Build and maintain documentation for your features and begin developing subject matter expertise in specific areas of the application.
* Assist in analyzing root causes for application issues and performance concerns; collaborate within the scrum team to triage and report defects.
* Learn and adhere to SDLC control processes and contribute ideas for continuous improvement.
* Perform functional validations to meet acceptance criteria; gain familiarity with Responsive Web Design validation and ADA Accessibility testing tools (e.g., NVDA, Voiceover, Talkback, Axe).
* Participate in team meetings and contribute to tracking progress against team objectives.
* Work effectively in a fast\-paced environment involving onshore and offshore teams.

Education, Qualification \& Certifications


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering or a related STEM field, or comparable work experience.
* 4\- 7 years of experience in full\-stack mobile development and/or testing in a professional environment.
* Basic familiarity with Behavior\-Driven Development (BDD) concepts; exposure to test automation frameworks such as Selenium with Cucumber is a plus.
* Exposure to or interest in cloud\-based development platforms such as OpenShift is desirable but not required.
* Basic working knowledge of collaboration and project management tools such as JIRA, Confluence, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Eagerness to learn, self\-motivated, and willing to take ownership of assigned tasks.
* Good written and oral communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively within a team.
